ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02709 is refunded in full to the rider. The deciding fact is the driver's position. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02709, weight 1.0) shows the driver never came closer than 647.3 m to the pickup pin at Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 — minimum distance 647.3 m, mean 3055.1 m, and zero qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. POL-NS-02 deems arrival only where at least three consecutive admissible fixes fall inside that radius; there are none, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the fee is not chargeable. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02709, weight 1.0) shows a BUTTON arrival tap at 07:38:35, and the trace puts the driver 647 m away at that moment, so under POL-NS-05 the marker is FALSE and cannot start the waiting clock; recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix there is none, so POL-NS-05(ii) applies — full refund, no compensation, and a false-arrival referral. Even on the driver's own clock the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period in force, so POL-NS-06 independently refunds the fee (shortfall 180 s). The fare ledger (EV-FARE-02709, weight 1.0) confirms SGD 4.50 charged, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The wrong-entrance clause POL-NS-03 does not rescue the fee: it reaches only a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, and this driver's nearest approach was 647.3 m, beyond even that ceiling. The rider's POL-NS-04 claims are noted but do not decide the case: her own track (60 stationary fixes, all within 13.8 m of the pin) and her 07:39:15 message 'where are you? i dont see any car' are consistent with her account, but the driver replied at 07:39:45, 30 seconds later and within the 120 second window, so POL-NS-04 limb (b) fails and that clause cannot exonerate her — the refund already follows from the driver's own evidence. The driver's counterparty statement ('I arrived and waited, the rider did not come') is contradicted by the trace and carries no weight; his driver-pressed BUTTON marker is not covered by POL-NS-12. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full, and it is not, and POL-NS-03(ii) goodwill does not arise because the driver was not within 400 m. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1 against 103 completed trips, rate about 0.01), so no escalation on that ground, and profile fields are credibility context only. The two claims about EV-ADVIS-02709-01 remain discarded (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT undisclosed); the missing advisory carries no deciding fact, and POL-NS-06(i) accumulation was never available. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes on issue. Confidence is 0.90, under a cap of 1.00 set by the GPS, trip and fare artifacts (all weight 1.0) that carry the deciding fact.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii): record a false-arrival event against driver DRV-09709 on trip TRP-02709 — the 'I'm Here' tap at 07:38:35 was made while the driver's GPS trace (EV-GPS-02709) placed him 647.3 m from the pickup pin, and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip.
